items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I beat him to the punch and I got there before and cancelled it all.

ctx.x: Yes. And I told them about (unintelligible). 'Good, you get them, you get them.' So he said, 'All right.' So he brought Snowden and his band to New York thinking that he was going to have the [Polley] Time but I beat him to the punch and I got there before and cancelled it all. Now, Fats stayed with me, Fats and Katie and all. So we went on, we got another dancer and still Liza and her Shuffling Sextet.
Now tell me about Liza, all this is so interesting, I want to pull out some of these things. Liza was like -- what was she -- a singer, right?
